risk_notes: The T1 probe requires observing real hook stdin, which means temporarily pointing a PostToolUse hook at a dump script. Do this via a clearly-named added probe hook entry and revert it in the same session - a left-behind probe hook will pollute every subsequent session. A negative result (payload carries no tool response) is a legitimate successful outcome of T1 and must be recorded rather than worked around; in that case T2 proceeds with spill-file stat plus MCP telemetry only, and the epic's AC2 coverage target must be renegotiated with the user because small non-spilled outputs would then be structurally unmeasurable.
